reddit.title: Improved Music Transitions in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the music transitions in Provincia! No more hard cuts between day, night, title, and combat beds. Our new long equal-power self-crossfade ensures a smoother experience, enhancing the immersive feel of your colony. Check out the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops

steam.title: Enhanced Audio Experience in Provincia
steam.body: We've made some exciting updates to the music in Provincia! The transitions between day, night, title, and combat beds are now smoother with our new crossfade system. This means no more hard cuts, just a seamless auditory experience as you build your colony. Read more about these changes and other updates here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
